$schema_note: Each palette must define bg, primary, accent, muted, text. Optional: safe, warn, danger, surface, surface_alt. All values are hex strings.

ask-arthur._description: Ask Arthur brand palette — deep navy primary, action teal accent, warm slate text. Sourced from apps/web/app/globals.css.

ask-arthur-dark._description: Inverted Ask Arthur palette for dark-mode diagrams or hero blog images on dark backgrounds.

neutral._description: Generic monochrome fallback when the diagram doesn't belong to a specific brand context (internal docs, scratch).

warm-editorial._description: Cream + deep navy + accent terracotta — matches the ask-arthur-warm-editorial illustration style for blog posts that already use those visuals.
